description: This file contains the class implementation of TaxRate, a model representing tax rate data within the OpenCart admin localisation module. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving tax rate information and associated customer groups.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Model class for managing tax rates, including CRUD operations and associations with customer groups.

methods.name: addTaxRate
methods.description: Inserts a new tax rate into the database and associates it with customer groups if provided.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Updates an existing tax rate and updates its customer group associations.

methods.name: deleteTaxRate
methods.description: Removes a tax rate and its associated customer group links from the database.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific tax rate, including related geo zone information.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Fetches multiple tax rates with optional sorting, pagination, and filtering.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRates
methods.description: Returns the total count of tax rates.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRatesByGeoZoneId
methods.description: Counts tax rates associated with a specific geo zone.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a tax rate with a customer group.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Removes all customer group associations for a given tax rate.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroupsByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Deletes associations for all tax rates linked to a specific customer group.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves customer groups associated with a specific tax rate.
